name: L10 PanoLab temporal exact-token then appearance router
question: Can frozen exact target-name evidence from reciprocal query frames recover the cross-condition appearance UNKNOWN without increasing wrong-target candidates?
observed_before_freeze: The temporal appearance result remained 1 correct, 0 wrong, 1 UNKNOWN. Human review had already shown the Rumillat name in newly downloaded reciprocal neighbours. OCR outputs and scores on all six temporal images remained unseen.

routing_contract.lexical: Run the exact frozen PP-OCRv6 medium entrance-window pipeline and long-short exact-token bank from l10_panolab_track_token_bank_fresh_protocol_v1.json across prev/anchor/next for every one of the six roster names.
routing_contract.unique_own_match: If and only if the requested target is the sole matched roster name, emit TEMPORAL_EXACT_TOKEN_SEARCH_PRIORITY_CANDIDATE.
routing_contract.no_match: Reuse the already sealed temporal appearance candidate or UNKNOWN without recomputation or threshold changes.
routing_contract.unique_wrong_or_multiple_matches: Return UNKNOWN_LEXICAL_CONFLICT_KEEP_SEARCHING; never let appearance override a lexical conflict.
routing_contract.authority: All emitted candidates remain SEARCH_PRIORITY_ONLY with no portal-ownership binding.

required: both consumed reciprocal sequences and all six frames evaluated
at least +1 correct over the sealed 1/2 temporal appearance fallback
0 wrong-target exact-token matches across 10 counterfactual trials
gate.failure_policy: Preserve the first result. No OCR threshold, token rule, image, crop, target alias, roster, or routing rule may change after output.

research_basis.title: GoMatching++: Parameter- and Data-Efficient Arbitrary-Shaped Video Text Spotting and Benchmarking
research_basis.use: Motivates accumulating text evidence over short and long temporal context. This router uses a deterministic exact-token bank, not GoMatching++.

research_basis.title: GloTSFormer: Global Video Text Spotting Transformer
research_basis.use: Motivates retaining global historical text evidence instead of adjacent-frame-only decisions. This router does not implement its Transformer.

claim_boundary.allowed: Consumed posthoc Development evidence about whether an unchanged exact-token temporal branch can complement an unchanged appearance branch on exactly FP01 and FP02 in one same-provider six-target closed roster.
not_allowed: fresh, blind, independent, provider-disjoint, city-disjoint, open-world, conformal, FDR-controlled, or deployment confirmation
a same-name OCR token proving exact entity identity, sign-to-building association, facade ownership, or portal ownership
access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, deployment performance, or safety
